entry: skins/attachments glue: createAttachment five-argument call + type jump table (0x28c7a0-0x28c7e4), spSkin_addAttachment + three-level advance (0x28cc68-0x28ccb8), type load stubs (0x28cf24-0x28cf3c), loader->error1 NULL split (0x28cf68-0x28cf78), loader error pair report (0x28cf78-0x28cfa8), ik/transform/path "Target ..." tails (0x28cf3c, 0x28d144, 0x28d170)
scope: Reconstructed glue C only: real spAttachmentLoader_createAttachment wrapper, real spSkin_addAttachment, real spSkeletonData_dispose, real _spSkeletonJson_setError, real Json accessors and allocator. The five jump-table landings call real module entry points that are REPLACED here by argument recorders (region/boundingbox/mesh/path field parsers belong to their own modules); the attachment loader record + vtable slot +0x00 are a recorder that can answer NULL, answer with any stored type, and publish error1/error2. 0x28bdcc, 0x28bdd8, 0x28ccb4 and the six §5.2 semantic gaps are NOT modelled. Not an original-equivalence claim.

not_translated: census §5.2 semantic gaps 0x28bf00/0x28bf28/0x28bf58/0x28c104/0x28c384/0x28c3b4 (inside other modules windows)
census §5.3 common epilogue 0x28bdcc..0x28bdd4 and the chain restores 0x28bdd8 / 0x28ccb4 / 0x28cc9c
the four field parsers the jump table lands in: region 0x28cdac (c/spine_read_region), boundingbox 0x28cd6c and path 0x28ca5c (c/spine_read_bbox_path), mesh/linkedmesh 0x28cb20 (c/spine_read_mesh)
the Atlas loader body 0x284a08 (synthetic vtable recorder here)
boundary.tail_entry_edges: 0x28bfa8 beq 0x28cf3c, 0x28c154 beq 0x28d144, 0x28c3fc beq 0x28d170 — all three are reached only with r0 == 0, so `ldr r3,[r4,#0x1c]` reads VA 0x1c in the original (latent NULL-page read); the fixture injects an argument record to observe offset and register source instead of faulting
